'''Nadir spiders''' were large, carnivourous arthropods native to the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]; similar species could be found within other comets and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Being silicon-based lifeforms like [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] or [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]], Nadir [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] were presumably capable of surviving in a vacuum, although they could survive in an atmosphere as well. The creature's body consisted of a large thorax covered in jagged plates, five spindly legs set at equidistant points, and a spiny head possessing five eyes and a single mouth with five beak-like mouths. The creatures were roughly the size of a man, and clever enough to ambush prospective prey from behind. In addition, Nadir spiders were capable of spewing a jet of corrosive acid to a range of approximately 7.5 meters.
